messages.text:
Looks that way, Jeff, sorry. The team closed at 6pm ET, so the three requests sit with them until Monday at 10am ET. They'll come back here, and the answer lands in your email at (email hidden) either way, so you don't need to wait in the chat over the weekend.

Nothing has changed on your side meanwhile. Both Bitaxe orders are on hold, nothing shipped, nothing cancelled.
